exact.✓ 正確！AND 只有 (1,1) 達標。: ✓ Correct! For AND, only (1,1) reaches the threshold.
exact.✗ 再想想：間值決定誰能鳴火。: ✗ Think again: the threshold decides who gets to fire.

cf5a0b37853f.zh:
第一顆人工神經元
McCulloch-Pitts Neuron
cf5a0b37853f.en:
The First Artificial Neuron
The McCulloch-Pitts Neuron

c2a8263a1098.zh: 在學會開法拉利之前，先弄清楚輪子怎麼發明 Before the Ferrari, learn the wheel.
c2a8263a1098.en: Before you learn to drive a Ferrari, first figure out how the wheel was invented

4312066f2ce9.zh: 大腦的神經元，能用數學模擬嗎？<small>Can neurons be simulated with mathematics?</small>
4312066f2ce9.en: Can the brain's neurons be simulated with mathematics?

564b3ad13675.zh: 名師導讀 · 為何回到 1943 Why travel back to 1943
564b3ad13675.en: Guided Reading · Why Go Back to 1943

789657df0564.zh: 很多人因為看見 ChatGPT 能寫詩、Midjourney 能繪圖而走進這門課，想學怎麼拯救世界，或者至少拯救自己的期末考。Drawn by ChatGPT and Midjourney, here to save the world — or the final exam.
789657df0564.en: Many people walk into this course because they have seen ChatGPT write poems and Midjourney draw pictures, and they want to learn how to save the world, or at least save their own final exam.

de7c721f3c80.zh: 但在學會開法拉利之前，得先弄清楚輪子怎麼發明。今天不敲程式碼、不死背公式，我們搭時光機回到 1943 年。Before the Ferrari, study the wheel; no coding, no rote formulas today.
de7c721f3c80.en: But before you learn to drive a Ferrari, you first have to figure out how the wheel was invented. Today we won't type code or memorize formulas; we'll hop into a time machine and go back to 1943.

14b22160f930.zh: 那時連真正的電子電腦都還沒誕生，神經生理學家 Warren McCulloch 與邏輯學家 Walter Pitts 坐在一起喝咖啡，靈光一閃：大腦神經元能否用數學模擬？Before computers existed, McCulloch and Pitts asked: can neurons be math?
14b22160f930.en: Back then, not even a true electronic computer had been born yet. The neurophysiologist Warren McCulloch and the logician Walter Pitts sat down together over coffee and had a flash of inspiration: could the brain's neurons be simulated with mathematics?

267fe38b4a43.zh: 1943：有原則的傳聲筒 A principled relay

51731918b723.en: Output 1 only if the total reaches the bar, else 0

b9d5e731b60e.zh: M-P 神經元：加總後過門檻 · Sum then threshold
b9d5e731b60e.en: M-P neuron: sum, then pass the threshold

300a425364cd.zh: 人類史上第一個「人工神經元」數學模型就此誕生，我們稱它為 McCulloch-Pitts 神經元 (M-P Neuron)。History's first artificial neuron model.
300a425364cd.en: And so the first mathematical model of an "artificial neuron" in human history was born. We call it the McCulloch-Pitts neuron (M-P neuron).

81b39467b060.zh: 它就像一個有原則的傳聲筒：把收到的 1 加起來，心裡有一道門檻，達標才大叫 1，沒達標就安靜輸出 0。A relay that shouts 1 only past its threshold.
81b39467b060.en: It is like a principled messenger: it adds up the 1s it receives and keeps a threshold in mind. Only when the total reaches the threshold does it shout 1; otherwise it quietly outputs 0.

642154eb251a.zh: 三個特點 · 簡單到不可思議 Three simple traits

55ce0dad80d5.zh: 只聽得懂 1 或 0，回答也只有 1 或 0，不搞曖昧。Only 1 or 0, never in-between.
55ce0dad80d5.en: It only understands 1 or 0, and it only ever answers 1 or 0. No mixed signals.

2072548a60cc.zh: 把所有 1 加起來，總分達標才輸出 1，否則輸出 0。Sum the ones; fire only past the bar.
2072548a60cc.en: Add up all the 1s; output 1 only if the total reaches the threshold, otherwise output 0.

de0388bc678d.zh: 每個訊號重要性都一樣，而且寫死不能改，生來什麼樣，一輩子什麼樣。Equal weights, frozen for life; no learning.
de0388bc678d.en: Every signal is equally important, and the weights are hard-coded and cannot change: however it is born, that is how it stays for life.

df0d8d83f440.zh: 為何偉大 · Why it matters

c2a55b96f99b.zh: 只要把足夠多這樣的簡單神經元連起來，就能實現 AND、OR、NOT 邏輯運算，等於用神經元做電腦能做的邏輯思考，為所有神經網路打下第一塊地基。Wired together, they compute AND, OR, NOT — the first foundation.
c2a55b96f99b.en: Connect enough of these simple neurons together and you can implement the logical operations AND, OR and NOT. That amounts to using neurons to do the logical reasoning a computer can do, and it laid the very first foundation stone for all neural networks.

097e10ef1812.zh: 數學形式 · 累積再開關 Sum then threshold

cc4fd4fb8af8.zh: 兩個特徵：$x_1$ 是不是紅色？$x_2$ 是不是圓形？M-P 約定每個輸入重要性都一樣。Two features, equal weights by design.
cc4fd4fb8af8.en: Two features: is it red ($x_1$)? Is it round ($x_2$)? By M-P convention, every input is equally important.

c7b25f4abab6.zh: 門檻設為 2：總分達標輸出 1，否則輸出 0。這就是 AND 的數學寫法。Threshold 2 encodes the AND logic.
c7b25f4abab6.en: Set the threshold to 2: if the total reaches it, output 1; otherwise output 0. This is how AND is written mathematically.

c7a08c216179.zh: 動手算 · 教它認紅蘋果 Spot the red apple
c7a08c216179.en: Hands-On Calculation · Teaching It to Recognize Red Apples

da030a5e06c0.zh: 總分 $(1 \times 1) + (1 \times 1) = \mathbf{2}$，達標輸出 1，是紅蘋果！Score 2, outputs 1 — a red apple.
da030a5e06c0.en: Total $(1 \times 1) + (1 \times 1) = \mathbf{2}$: it reaches the threshold and outputs 1. It's a red apple!

0a4f274e4d98.zh: 總分 $(0 \times 1) + (0 \times 1) = \mathbf{0}$，未達標輸出 0，不是紅蘋果。Score 0, outputs 0 — not an apple.
0a4f274e4d98.en: Total $(0 \times 1) + (0 \times 1) = \mathbf{0}$: it falls short of the threshold and outputs 0. Not a red apple.

42056588f6a9.zh: 總分 $(0 \times 1) + (1 \times 1) = \mathbf{1}$，未達標輸出 0，也不是紅蘋果。Score 1, outputs 0 — not an apple.
42056588f6a9.en: Total $(0 \times 1) + (1 \times 1) = \mathbf{1}$: it falls short of the threshold and outputs 0. Not a red apple either.

e45d39321a8a.zh: 總分與輸出 · Score versus output

4ab570f6f46a.zh: 幾何魔法 · 一條線切開世界 One line splits the world
4ab570f6f46a.en: Geometric Magic · One Line Splits the World

69b661858e97.zh: 左 AND 門檻 2 · 右 OR 門檻 1 · matplotlib 精準繪製
69b661858e97.en: Left: AND, threshold 2 · Right: OR, threshold 1 · drawn precisely with matplotlib

8214e95bb699.zh: 直線 $x_1 + x_2 = 2$ 把唯一的 (1, 1) 與 (0, 0)、(0, 1)、(1, 0) 完全分開，呈現線性可分。Line isolates (1,1); linearly separable.
8214e95bb699.en: The line $x_1 + x_2 = 2$ completely separates the lone point (1, 1) from (0, 0), (0, 1) and (1, 0): the data are linearly separable.

c9f8158c06c6.zh: 門檻調低為 1，切割線變為 $x_1 + x_2 = 1$ 向左下方平移，只有 (0, 0) 歸為 0。Lower the bar; the boundary shifts.
c9f8158c06c6.en: Lower the threshold to 1 and the cutting line becomes $x_1 + x_2 = 1$, shifted toward the lower left; only (0, 0) is classified as 0.

fdc0a13d9716.zh: 單層網路透過調整門檻，在幾何空間中移動決策邊界。One threshold slides the whole boundary.
fdc0a13d9716.en: By adjusting its threshold, a single-layer network moves its decision boundary through geometric space.

3096ff634b66.zh: 鷹架小結 · 偉大與致命傷 Takeaway and flaw
3096ff634b66.en: Scaffolded Summary · Greatness and the Fatal Flaw

0ca9b8dbfc2c.zh: M-P 模型把「累積訊號、超過門檻就開關」的生物直覺，正式翻譯成「加權和 $\to$ 閾值啟動」的數學形式。Biology translated into sum-to-threshold math.
0ca9b8dbfc2c.en: The M-P model formally translated the biological intuition of "accumulate signals, switch on once past the threshold" into the mathematical form "weighted sum $\to$ threshold activation".

e1c2b144a9f1.zh: 權重固定、不能學習：教小孩認蘋果，卻不准他從錯誤中長大。下一節的感知機 (Perceptron)，正是為了解開「不能學習」而誕生。Fixed weights, no learning — Perceptron comes next.
e1c2b144a9f1.en: The weights are fixed and it cannot learn: it is like teaching a child to recognize apples but forbidding them to grow from their mistakes. The perceptron in the next section was born precisely to fix this "cannot learn" problem.

ebb937cdc753.zh: 等權固定、無學習，但證明神經元可做邏輯運算。Logic from neurons, no learning yet.
ebb937cdc753.en: Equal, fixed weights and no learning, but it proved that neurons can perform logical operations.

232239016b9d.zh: 解開「不能學習」：權重可從錯誤中更新。Weights learn from mistakes.
232239016b9d.en: Fixes "cannot learn": the weights can be updated from mistakes.

86229b271cb7.zh: 下節課看 Perceptron 怎麼讓神經元動起來。Next: neurons that move.
86229b271cb7.en: Next lesson: we'll see how the perceptron gets neurons moving.

c70b84166dd2.en: Q1. For AND logic with weights [1, 1], what should the threshold be set to?

ba59e3fb9b23.zh: Q2. M-P 模型的致命限制是什麼？ Fatal limit of M-P?
ba59e3fb9b23.en: Q2. What is the fatal limitation of the M-P model?

a2c4b511c994.zh: 輸入太多 — too many inputs

bf68d985309f.zh: 公式太難 — math too hard

1dd150df75e4.zh: 權重固定、不能學習 — fixed weights, no learning
1dd150df75e4.en: The weights are fixed and it cannot learn
